jobs.title: Client Sales Director (Financial/Trading Vertical)
jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With
As a team member of the Arista Sales team, you are the face of Arista to our customers; their internal champion for the problems they need to solve. As their champion you will align Arista’s technical resources to achieve your customer’s business outcome. You will partner with some of the most skilled Customer Engineers in the industry in addition to our Professional Services and Executive teams to help them understand how to execute on your customer’s behalf. Our sales teams have a culture of team success, where you’ll collaborate and be supported by like minded sales professionals. This role typically reports to a Regional Sales Manager or Area VP of Sales.
What You'll Do
We are seeking a proven Client Sales Director to join our growing Sales organization in the New York City market. The Client Director role is expected to be a trusted advisor to key C-levels with a key Arista Financial Trading customer and implement a strategic sales strategy to intimately understand their business drivers and expand our footprint.
Arista appeals to forward-thinking organizations that value quality and innovation. Consequently, technical acumen and a track record of selling data center solutions is highly desirable.
Job Responsibilities:
- Exceed key stakeholder demands with a key Arista account and foster executive level relationship
- You will be responsible for utilizing a consultative selling approach with key client stakeholders to address the business needs of quantum analytics and the financial trading vertical market by positioning Arista's data-driven product portfolio of Software-Driven High Performance Data Center and AI Networking solutions.
- Meet with key influencers, decision-makers, and C-levels to present Arista’s value proposition.
- Work with Arista systems engineers to design and position compelling solutions that drive down the total cost of ownership.
- Collaborate with technology partners to identify prospects and demonstrate best-in-class solutions.
- Establish and manage key channel relationships in your territory.
- Formulate strategic and tactical account plans based on periodic business reviews with your prospects and customers.
- Conduct demand generation activities such as happy hours, lunch-n-learns and technology forums.
- Collaborate with Arista peers on marketing plans and best practices.
- Keep up-to-date with technology partner solutions, competing solutions and competitor strategies.
You are a Sales Leader and have a proven track record of technology of strategic selling and pursing large big bet deals within the Fortune 500. You are an influencer and possess the ability to act as a trusted advisor to deliver business value to both end users and C-level key business stakeholders.
Our team looks for individuals who embody our values of trust, compassion, collaboration, respectfulness, integrity, and good-natured fun.
Minimum Job Requirements:
- BS/BA degree or equivalent in addition to 15+ years of technology sales experience.
- Strong leadership skills and the ability to be an executive influencer.
- Proven track record of strategic selling and closing $20M - $50M deals within the Financial and/or Trading / Equity vertical.
- You possess relevant data center or networking (LAN/WAN, SDN) industry background from a technology partner, competitor, channel partner or end user is a a requirement.
- Strong rolodex and relationships within the territory
- Excellent people skills and ability to build relationships at all levels
- You possess previous selling experience and technical acumen in one or more of the following areas; Networking, SDN, NFV, Switching, Network Automation, Routing, Data Center, Edge Computing, Network Virtualization, Hyper converged infrastructure or Cloud computing.

Compensation Information
The new hire base pay for this role has a salary range of $130,000 to $180,000. The actual salary offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and US location. The salary range provided reflects the base salary and in addition may also be eligible for discretionary Arista bonuses, commissions, equity, and benefits including medical, dental, vision, wellbeing, tax savings and income protection. The recruiting team can share more details during the hiring process specific to the role and location.
#LI-TC1
Arista Networks is an equal opportunity employer.  Arista makes all hiring and employment-related decisions in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or any other factor determined to be unlawful under applicable federal, state, or law law.  All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager (Ontario)
jobs.description:
*Qualified candidates must reside in the Greater Toronto Area and have a proven track record of successfully selling networking solutions within the local market.

Who You'll Work With
As a team member of the Arista Sales team, you are the face of Arista to our customers; their internal champion for the problems they need to solve. As their champion you will align Arista’s technical resources to achieve your customer’s business outcome. You will partner with some of the most skilled Customer Engineers in the industry in addition to our Professional Services and Executive teams to help them understand how to execute on your customer’s behalf. Our sales teams have a culture of team success, where you’ll collaborate and be supported by like minded sales professionals. This role typically reports to either Regional Sales Director or  Area VP of Sales.
What Will You Do?
Arista has an exciting and challenging career opportunity available for a Regional Sales Manager in the Toronto metro area to lead an accomplished team of Account Managers and Channel Partners in a player/coach capacity with the goal of exceeding revenue target goals for the territory. This role will be instrumental in driving new revenue for Arista's Open Networking platforms.
Responsibilities include but not limited to the following;
- You will lead, manage and mentor a small team of highly successful Account Managers in Toronto in a player/coach capacity.
- You will develop a strategic go-to market business plan to meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue goals for the Greater Toronto Area.
- Build sales pipeline by developing relationships with top tier prospects, partners, and customers
- Hire, develop, motivate, and retain top sales talent for the region through coaching and mentoring
- Manage and grow new customer relationships and revenue associated with Arista's Cognitive Cloud Networking solutions and switching platforms including Cognitive Campus WI-FI, and AI Networking products in addition to our DANZ Automated Fabric Monitoring, Network Detection & Response, End Point security and AI-driven Network Identity solutions.
- Prospect and develop partner resellers in the territory
- Build mutually beneficial relationships with value-add resellers and grow business through these partnerships
- Participate in marketing program planning, development, execution, and measurement to ensure that programs succeed according to plan
- Interface with Arista headquarters to coordinate sales and marketing activity
- Monitor client satisfaction and elevate issues of dissatisfaction for quick resolution
- Foster and facilitate a collaborative team environment which intersects empowerment with accountability in a matrix management organization structure
- Set own priorities and schedules to meet established goals and meet commitments consistently
- Other duties as assigned by management

Ideal Candidate has the following attributes:
- Sales leadership experience leading a senior sales team
- Experience selling into large enterprise organizations
- Ability to inspire team to take on challenges and stay positive on path to success
- Sales success in territory / relationships with key contacts for target accounts
- Network Sales experience and understanding of Data Center, Campus and Cloud technologies
- Knowledge of local and regional market space and relationships with Arista partners in the Data Center technology area
- Passion for success and ability to articulate innovation that can compel clients to break the status quo
As a candidate for this role, you will apply your Sales leadership experience working with an accomplished team of Account Managers while working for one of the fastest growing Networking OEM's that is transforming Data Center and Campus networks leveraging Arista's Software-Driven Cloud Networking platforms.
The ideal candidate can balance strategic and operational issues while communicating the overall strategy strategy and business plan to stakeholders while also carrying their own bag.
Requirements :
- A BA/BS degree
- 12+ years sales experience in high tech-preferably in the networking sector, routers/switches or competitor such as Cisco, Juniper, Extreme or Aruba.
- Previous experience managing, leading and building Sales teams.
- Demonstrated history of consistent sales achievement over target
- Consistent track record for developing new business and managing a complex sales cycle, from generating leads to closing deals
- Core Domain knowledge of networking solutions, network routers/switches and selling into data center and campus environments.
- Demonstrated success with CXO and multi-level selling
- Highly motivated professional with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong customer service orientation and ability to develop and maintain relationships
- Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
- Strong time management, ability to multi-task, takes initiative and follows through
- Strong work ethic and commitment to integrity
Arista offers different pay ranges based on work location, so that we can offer consistent and competitive pay appropriate to the market. The actual base pay offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and work location.

The pay range provided reflects base pay only and in addition certain roles may also be eligible for discretionary Arista bonuses and equity. Employees in Sales roles are eligible to participate in Arista’s Sales Incentive Plan, which pays commissions calculated as a percentage of eligible sales. Employees are also entitled to benefits including medical, dental, vision, wellbeing, income protection and a Group Retirement Savings Plan. This posting is for an existing, open position within our team. The recruiting team can share more details during the hiring process specific to the role and location.
#LI-TC1

jobs.title: Manufacturing Partner Manager - Penang
jobs.description:
Who You Will Work With

Support the management and performance of Arista’s global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) partners. Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Contract Manufacturers to drive manufacturing competitiveness, cost performance, operational excellence, and New Product Introduction (NPI).

What You'll Do
- Manage day-to-day and strategic business engagement with assigned EMS partners, ensuring alignment on cost, quality, delivery, inventory, capacity, and operational performance.
- Support RFQs, manufacturing award decisions, and volume allocation strategies through financial, operational, and capacity analysis.
- Monitor Manufacturing Value Add (MVA) performance and support quarterly cost negotiations through benchmarking, cost analysis, and savings opportunity identification.
- Develop and maintain manufacturing spend reporting, spend split analysis, cost reduction tracking, and sourcing performance metrics.
- Coordinate the Contract Manufacturer Quarterly Business Review (QBR) process, including scorecards, performance assessments, executive presentations, and action plan tracking.
- Analyze manufacturing competitiveness across sites and partners, identifying opportunities to improve cost, scalability, and operational efficiency.
- Support NPI manufacturing strategy, including site selection, capability assessments, production readiness reviews, and manufacturing ramp activities.
- Drive resolution of supply chain, operational, quality, and fulfillment issues with manufacturing partners and internal stakeholders.
- Monitor manufacturing partner performance against business commitments and drive accountability for corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Support capacity planning, footprint optimization, and supply chain risk mitigation activities across the global manufacturing network.
- Develop executive-level reporting and business reviews highlighting manufacturing performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic initiatives.
- Partner cross-functionally to support manufacturing strategy, sourcing decisions, cost reduction programs, and business growth objectives.
- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Business, Finance, or related field.
- 5–8 years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, operations, supplier management, or program management.
- Experience working with contract manufacturers and global supply chains.
- Strong analytical, financial, and problem-solving skills.
- Experience with cost analysis, supplier performance management, and sourcing activities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and influence stakeholders across functions.
- Strong communication and presentation skills.
- Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
- Must be based in Penang with legal work rights.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager - Taiwan or Penang, Malaysia
jobs.description:
Who You’ll Work With
Arista is seeking an experienced Supply Chain Manager with expertise on on Liquid Cooling and Cold Plate technologies. He/ she will responsible for ensuring continuity of supply, cost management, leading process improvements, material planning and execution. He/she will work closely with, Contract Manufacturing(CM), Component suppliers, Global Supplier  Management(GSM), and new product introduction (NPI) Supply Chain teams.
What You’ll Do
The ideal candidate will be excellent in leadership, communication, and collaborating cross functionally and partnering with CM/ODM.
- Represent Supply Chain CM management team to lead or co-lead CM bring up projects.
- Develop and implement metrics with the CM to ensure accountability and identifying performance improvement opportunities.
- Communication with critical stakeholders, coordination, and alignment with CM to support build plan.
- Partner with the CM, component suppliers and GSM managers on all identified material issues and resolve them by identifying the root cause and managing the corrective or recovery actions.
- Allocate components that are in short supply in a manner that maximizes revenue, minimizes impacts to key performance indicators, and minimizes escalations from customers.
- Issue RFQ, perform competitive cost analysis, and negotiate cost with component suppliers, distributors, and CMs.
- Ensure cost is competitive while meeting other priority goals such as quality and delivery.
- Oversee Excess and Obsolete (E&O) activity from CMs, recommend critical courses of action to management, and own efforts to mitigate liability to Arista.
- Support business critical events such as cycle count, physical inventory & quarter ends. This may occasionally require work during weekends and holidays.
- Bachelor’s degree, preferably in supply chain, business, economics, finance or a related field.
- 10 years of progressive supply chain operations experience, preferably with Liquid Cooling material management experience in a high-tech operations environment. Ideally candidates hold min 5 years of OEM experience.
- Track record of delivering excellence in projects
- Program management, communication, negotiating and influencing experience with a track record of achieving solid business results.
- Ability to work in a dynamic & ambiguous fast-paced environment.
- Top notch data management skill. Excellent in compiling and analyzing large data in excel.
- Self-motivated, experienced working as part of a global, cross-functional team who are located in Asia, North America & Europe time zones. Must be able to occasionally work outside of standard local business hours.
- Strong relationship management skills.
- Travel ~10% a year
This role is open to the candidate based in Taiwan or Penang (Malaysia) or Hanoi (Vietnam) with the hand on legal work rights. #LI-AN1

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist, APAC
jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With
As part of the regional marketing team, you will collaborate closely with APAC Sales and Engineering to equip them with compelling content and sales enablement assets. You’ll serve as the bridge to Global Marketing and Content teams to localize campaigns, work with Product and Technical Marketing to translate complex features into clear customer stories, and coordinate with external agencies and channel partners to execute joint demand-generation programs across the region.
What You’ll Do
The Marketing Specialist, APAC will play a critical role in supporting the regional team to execute integrated campaigns that drive demand, build brand awareness, and increase market share across the Asia-Pacific region. This hands-on role focuses on product marketing, technical content development, and campaign execution in close collaboration with APAC sales, engineering, and global marketing teams. The specialist will translate technical information into customer-friendly messaging and ensure the timely delivery of marketing activities aligned with regional priorities.
Key Responsibilities
Product Marketing and Messaging
- Develop and adapt product marketing content, including case studies and presentations, by localizing global messaging to suit the APAC market’s specific technical and business requirements.
- Assist in creating product positioning and value proposition materials that resonate with APAC customers’ needs and use cases.
- Produce and maintain sales enablement assets to equip the APAC sales team with clear, compelling product information and messaging.

Technical Marketing Support
- Collaborate with technical marketing and engineering to produce technical blog posts, customer use cases, and feature highlight content tailored for technical buyers.
- Help create technical collateral and diagrams that clarify product capabilities for customers and partners.

Campaign Execution
- Coordinate and support the execution of regional marketing campaigns by delivering assets on schedule.
- Assist with demand-generation initiatives, including email campaigns, webinars, and digital marketing activities, ensuring alignment with campaign plans.
- Manage regional marketing content calendars and support social media updates and digital marketing tasks.
- Monitor basic campaign metrics and assist in preparing performance reports to help improve future initiatives.

Regional and Partner Support
- Support channel marketing activities by executing joint campaigns and distributing co-branded content for partners.
- Serve as a communication bridge between APAC sales, product, and global marketing teams to ensure executional alignment and flow of information.
- Provide local insights to ensure marketing activities meet the cultural and commercial context of various APAC markets.
- 5+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing with a focus on product or technical marketing execution.
- Good technical understanding and ability to simplify complex technology concepts for marketing content.
- Strong project coordination skills, capable of managing multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Familiarity with APAC markets, showing awareness of regional customer needs and cultural nuances.
- Familiarity with enterprise technology, especially networking, is a plus.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.
- Proficient in CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot), and basic marketing analytics.
- Collaborative team player who works effectively across functions and with external agencies.
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.
